description: This Java class defines a command named 'Whoami' used to retrieve information about the current user in a system. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and managing headers, and is annotated for JSON parsing and immutability.

classes.name: Whoami
classes.description: Immutable command class used to query information about the current user. It provides static factory methods to create instances from headers or JSON objects and overrides standard methods for object equality, hashing, and string representation.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Overrides parent method to append payload to JSON builder; intentionally empty as no additional data is needed for this command.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Whoami command from given headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Whoami command instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new Whoami instance with updated headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for object equality, considering superclass properties and class type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on superclass implementation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation including class details.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns an array of supported JSON schema versions, in this case, only version 2.
